ucs.title: [LLM] Qilin / Agenda — SafeBoot tampering for EDR-bypass pre-encryption reboot
ucs.description: Hunts the Qilin (a.k.a. Agenda) ransomware-as-a-service signature pre-encryption move: editing the Boot Configuration Data to force `safeboot network`, killing shadow copies, then triggering a reboot so the encryptor runs in Safe Mode where most AV/EDR drivers are unloaded. This bcdedit+vssadmin+reboot chain on the same host within minutes is highly Qilin-specific and was observed across multiple 2024-2025 Qilin intrusions (incl. Synnovis/NHS).
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=true count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Processes.process) as cmd values(Processes.parent_process_name) as parent values(Processes.user) as user from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where Processes.process_name IN ("bcdedit.exe","vssadmin.exe","wmic.exe","powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","cmd.exe") AND (Processes.process="*safeboot*" OR Processes.process="*shadowcopy*delete*" OR Processes.process="*delete shadows*" OR Processes.process="*Set-ItemProperty*Network*" OR Processes.process="*safebootminimal*") by host Processes.user _time span=10m | eventstats dc(Processes.process_name) as distinct_tools by host | where distinct_tools>=2 OR cmd="*safeboot*network*" | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | sort 0 -firstTime
ucs.kql:
// Qilin SafeBoot tampering — bcdedit safeboot + shadow copy nuking on same host within 30m
let WindowMin = 30m;
let SafeBootEdits = DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(7d)
    | where AccountName !endswith "$"
    | where (FileName =~ "bcdedit.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has "safeboot")
         or (FileName in~ ("reg.exe","powershell.exe","pwsh.exe") and ProcessCommandLine has_all ("SafeBoot","Network"))
    | project SafeBootTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName, AccountName,
              SafeBootCmd = ProcessCommandLine, SafeBootParent = InitiatingProcessFileName;
let RecoveryNuke = DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(7d)
    | where AccountName !endswith "$"
    | where (FileName =~ "vssadmin.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has "delete shadows")
         or (FileName =~ "wmic.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has_all ("shadowcopy","delete"))
         or (FileName in~ ("powershell.exe","pwsh.exe") and ProcessCommandLine has_any ("Win32_Shadowcopy","Remove-WmiObject Win32_Shadowcopy"))
         or (FileName =~ "bcdedit.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has_any ("recoveryenabled no","bootstatuspolicy ignoreallfailures"))
    | project NukeTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, NukeCmd = ProcessCommandLine, NukeBin = FileName;
SafeBootEdits
| join kind=inner RecoveryNuke on DeviceId
| where abs(datetime_diff('minute', NukeTime, SafeBootTime)) <= 30
| summarize SafeBootCmds = make_set(SafeBootCmd, 5),
            RecoveryNukeCmds = make_set(NukeCmd, 5),
            FirstSeen = min(SafeBootTime), LastSeen = max(NukeTime)
            by DeviceId, DeviceName, AccountName
| order by FirstSeen desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
// Qilin SafeBoot tampering — SecurityEvent 4688 (requires CommandLine auditing) + WindowsEvent fallback
let WindowMin = 30m;
let SafeBootEdits = SecurityEvent
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
    | where EventID == 4688
    | where Account !endswith "$"
    | where (NewProcessName endswith "\\bcdedit.exe" and CommandLine has "safeboot")
         or (NewProcessName endswith_any ("\\reg.exe","\\powershell.exe","\\pwsh.exe") and CommandLine has_all ("SafeBoot","Network"))
    | project SafeBootTime = TimeGenerated, Computer, Account, SafeBootCmd = CommandLine, SafeBootBin = NewProcessName;
let RecoveryNuke = SecurityEvent
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
    | where EventID == 4688
    | where Account !endswith "$"
    | where (NewProcessName endswith "\\vssadmin.exe" and CommandLine has "delete shadows")
         or (NewProcessName endswith "\\wmic.exe" and CommandLine has_all ("shadowcopy","delete"))
         or (NewProcessName endswith_any ("\\powershell.exe","\\pwsh.exe") and CommandLine has_any ("Win32_Shadowcopy","Remove-WmiObject Win32_Shadowcopy"))
         or (NewProcessName endswith "\\bcdedit.exe" and CommandLine has_any ("recoveryenabled no","bootstatuspolicy ignoreallfailures"))
    | project NukeTime = TimeGenerated, Computer, NukeCmd = CommandLine, NukeBin = NewProcessName;
SafeBootEdits
| join kind=inner RecoveryNuke on Computer
| where abs(datetime_diff('minute', NukeTime, SafeBootTime)) <= 30
| summarize SafeBootCmds = make_set(SafeBootCmd, 5),
            RecoveryNukeCmds = make_set(NukeCmd, 5),
            FirstSeen = min(SafeBootTime), LastSeen = max(NukeTime)
            by Computer, Account
| order by FirstSeen desc
ucs.sigma_yaml:
title: Qilin / Agenda Ransomware SafeBoot Tampering
id: c3a17e9e-2f1a-4b22-9f8d-qilinsafe01
status: experimental
description: Detects bcdedit / reg / PowerShell setting the system into Safe Mode with networking — a hallmark Qilin (Agenda) pre-encryption step to evade EDR drivers that don't load in Safe Mode.
references:
  - https://www.trendmicro.com/en_us/research/24/h/qilin-ransomware.html
  - https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/security/blog/2024/06/27/qilin-ransomware-agenda/
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2025/06/01
tags:
  - attack.impact
  - attack.t1562.009
  - attack.t1490
  - attack.t1486
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection_bcdedit:
    Image|endswith: '\bcdedit.exe'
    CommandLine|contains: 'safeboot'
  selection_reg:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\reg.exe'
      - '\powershell.exe'
      - '\pwsh.exe'
    CommandLine|contains|all:
      - 'SafeBoot'
      - 'Network'
  filter_legit:
    User|endswith: '$'
  condition: (selection_bcdedit or selection_reg) and not filter_legit
falsepositives:
  - Legitimate troubleshooting by IT staff (extremely rare; should pair with change ticket)
  - Driver developers using SafeBoot to test boot-time behaviour
level: high
ucs.datadog_query: source:windows.sysmon @EventID:1 (@Image:(*\bcdedit.exe OR *\BCDEDIT.EXE OR *\BCDEdit.exe) @CommandLine:(*safeboot* OR *SafeBoot* OR *SAFEBOOT*)) OR (@Image:(*\vssadmin.exe OR *\VSSADMIN.EXE OR *\VSSAdmin.exe) @CommandLine:(*"delete shadows"* OR *"Delete Shadows"*)) OR (@Image:(*\wmic.exe OR *\WMIC.exe OR *\WMIC.EXE) @CommandLine:(*shadowcopy* OR *ShadowCopy*) @CommandLine:(*delete* OR *Delete*)) -@User:*$
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2
| (ImageFileName=/\\bcdedit\.exe$/i CommandLine=/safeboot/i) OR (ImageFileName=/\\(vssadmin|wmic)\.exe$/i CommandLine=/(delete\s+shadows|shadowcopy.*delete)/i) OR (ImageFileName=/\\(reg|powershell|pwsh)\.exe$/i CommandLine=/SafeBoot.*Network/i)
| NOT UserName=/\$$/
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, UserName], function={ collect([ImageFileName, CommandLine, ParentBaseFileName]) | count() })
| _count >= 2
ucs.rationale: Qilin/Agenda is one of the very few ransomware families that *intentionally* reboots victims into Safe Mode with networking before running its encryptor — Microsoft, Trend Micro and Sophos all flagged the bcdedit+safeboot+vssadmin chain as a Qilin signature in 2024. The same combination is rarely seen in legitimate IT activity (driver troubleshooting is the only real benign case), making the join

ucs.title: [LLM] Qilin / Agenda — ESXi/vCenter Linux encryptor staging via SSH + chmod+x in /tmp
ucs.description: Hunts the Qilin Linux/ESXi variant deployment chain. After valid-account access to vCenter or ESXi, affiliates SSH in, drop the Go/Rust ELF binary to /tmp or /var/tmp, chmod +x, then invoke it with a vmdk/vmx target list. This sequence on an ESXi host within minutes is a textbook Qilin ESXi affiliate playbook documented across Symantec, Group-IB and Mandiant Qilin reports in 2024-2025.
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=true count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Processes.process) as cmds values(Processes.user) as user values(Processes.parent_process_name) as parent from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where (Processes.os=Linux OR host=*esx* OR host=*vcenter*) AND Processes.process_name IN ("chmod","sh","bash","esxcli","vim-cmd","sshd") AND (Processes.process="*chmod*+x*/tmp/*" OR Processes.process="*chmod*+x*/var/tmp/*" OR Processes.process="*vim-cmd*vmsvc/power.off*" OR Processes.process="*esxcli*vm*process*kill*") by host Processes.user _time span=15m | eventstats dc(Processes.process_name) as tool_count by host | where tool_count>=2 OR cmds="*chmod*+x*/tmp/*" AND cmds="*vim-cmd*power.off*" | sort 0 -firstTime
ucs.kql:
// Qilin ESXi/Linux encryptor staging — chmod +x of /tmp binary followed by vmdk targeting on the same host
let StagingWindow = 15m;
let ChmodDrops = DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(7d)
    | where DeviceName has_any ("esx","vcenter","vsphere") or InitiatingProcessFolderPath startswith "/"
    | where FileName =~ "chmod"
    | where ProcessCommandLine matches regex @"(?i)\+x.*\/(tmp|var\/tmp|dev\/shm)\/"
    | where AccountName !in~ ("root","vpxuser") or InitiatingProcessFileName in~ ("sshd","bash","sh")
    | project ChmodTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName, AccountName,
              ChmodCmd = ProcessCommandLine,
              StagedPath = extract(@"(?i)(\/(?:tmp|var\/tmp|dev\/shm)\/[^\s;|]+)", 1, ProcessCommandLine);
let VmHostileActions = DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(7d)
    | where ProcessCommandLine has_any ("vim-cmd vmsvc/power.off",
                                        "esxcli vm process kill",
                                        ".vmdk", ".vmx", ".vmsd", ".vswp")
         or FileName in~ ("vim-cmd","esxcli")
    | project ActionTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, ActionCmd = ProcessCommandLine, ActionBin = FileName;
ChmodDrops
| join kind=inner VmHostileActions on DeviceId
| where ActionTime between (ChmodTime .. ChmodTime + StagingWindow)
| summarize StagedBinaries = make_set(StagedPath, 10),
            ChmodCmds = make_set(ChmodCmd, 10),
            VmActions = make_set(ActionCmd, 10),
            FirstSeen = min(ChmodTime), LastSeen = max(ActionTime)
            by DeviceId, DeviceName, AccountName
| order by FirstSeen desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
// Qilin ESXi/Linux encryptor staging via Syslog + auditd-style telemetry
let StagingWindow = 15m;
let ChmodDrops = Syslog
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
    | where Facility in~ ("auth","authpriv","daemon","user","kern")
    | where Computer has_any ("esx","vcenter","vsphere") or SyslogMessage has_any ("esxcli","vim-cmd")
    | where SyslogMessage matches regex @"(?i)chmod\s+(\+x|0?7\d\d).*\/(tmp|var\/tmp|dev\/shm)\/"
    | extend StagedPath = extract(@"(?i)(\/(?:tmp|var\/tmp|dev\/shm)\/[^\s;|]+)", 1, SyslogMessage)
    | project ChmodTime = TimeGenerated, Computer, HostIP, ChmodMsg = SyslogMessage, StagedPath;
let VmHostileActions = Syslog
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
    | where SyslogMessage has_any ("vim-cmd vmsvc/power.off",
                                   "esxcli vm process kill",
                                   ".vmdk",".vmx",".vmsd",".vswp")
    | project ActionTime = TimeGenerated, Computer, ActionMsg = SyslogMessage;
ChmodDrops
| join kind=inner VmHostileActions on Computer
| where ActionTime between (ChmodTime .. ChmodTime + StagingWindow)
| summarize StagedBinaries = make_set(StagedPath, 10),
            ChmodMsgs = make_set(ChmodMsg, 10),
            VmActions = make_set(ActionMsg, 10),
            FirstSeen = min(ChmodTime), LastSeen = max(ActionTime)
            by Computer, HostIP
| order by FirstSeen desc
ucs.datadog_query: source:linux.auditd @auditd.type:EXECVE (@process.command_line:(*"chmod +x /tmp/"* OR *"chmod +x /var/tmp/"* OR *"chmod 755 /tmp/"* OR *"chmod 777 /tmp/"*) OR (@process.name:(chmod OR CHMOD) @process.command_line:(*+x* OR *755* OR *777*) @process.command_line:(*/tmp/* OR */var/tmp/* OR */dev/shm/*)) OR @process.command_line:(*"vim-cmd vmsvc/power.off"* OR *"esxcli vm process kill"*)) (@host.name:*esx* OR @host.name:*vcenter* OR @host.name:*vsphere* OR @process.command_line:(*.vmdk* OR *.vmx*))
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2
| (ImageFileName=/\/chmod$/ CommandLine=/(\+x|0?7\d\d).*\/(tmp|var\/tmp|dev\/shm)\//i) OR (CommandLine=/vim-cmd\s+vmsvc\/power\.off|esxcli\s+vm\s+process\s+kill|\.vmdk|\.vmx/i)
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, UserName], function={ collect([ImageFileName, CommandLine, ParentBaseFileName]) | count() })
| _count >= 2
ucs.rationale: Qilin runs a dedicated Go-based ESXi/Linux encryptor branded internally as 'Agenda' that affiliates deploy via SSH after valid-account compromise of vCenter — Symantec, Group-IB, and Mandiant all document the chmod+x in /tmp followed by `vim-cmd vmsvc/power.off` (to release VM file locks before encryption) as the canonical pre-encryption sequence. Detecting the chmod-of-tmp-binary + vim-cmd/esxcli
